subject.title: fix(approvals): identify the originating session in approval prompts

question: Should this PR expose formatApprovalIdentityForDisplay as public Plugin SDK API and render the full sanitized sessionKey in channel-delivered approval prompt text?
rationale: The code path is a clean shared fix, but public SDK growth and identity disclosure in approval prompts are compatibility and security-UX choices that automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept SDK And Full Session Display
options.body: Land the additive SDK helper and full sanitized Session line because it keeps bundled plugins inside the SDK boundary and matches existing approval metadata routing.

options.title: Keep Formatter Internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK export and keep the formatter internal or plugin-local if maintainers do not want this helper as third-party API.

options.title: Redact Session Display
options.body: Change the visible Session value to an approved shorter label if maintainers do not want raw session identifiers shown in prompt text.

recommendation.title: Accept SDK And Full Session Display
recommendation.body: Land the additive SDK helper and full sanitized Session line because it keeps bundled plugins inside the SDK boundary and matches existing approval metadata routing.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest signal from current-main blame, live assignment, and the PR-head commits that added sanitizer and SDK surface budget changes.
